beats.speech: Passively rereading word lists really only trains your brain to recognize words on a page,
but if you want to effortlessly retrieve those words in a real conversation, you've got to change how you study.
People who practice active recall remember about 61% of what they studied a week later, while passive rereaders hit only 40%.

quiz.q_sub: Say it before you see it.
quiz.a_sub: A match-deciding penalty kick is crucial.

beats.speech: Instead of just memorizing ways to say very important, link them to clear images. A match-deciding penalty kick is crucial.
The air in a diver's tank is vital,
and a passport on a trip abroad is essential.
Read the meaning, say the word out loud, and then check the answer.

quiz.q_sub: Say it before you see it.
quiz.a_sub: I'm completely swamped with reports this week.

beats.speech: If you're very busy, you're swamped.

quiz.q: A burst pipe you must fix right now → *?*
quiz.q_sub: Very important, and it can't wait.

beats.speech: A burst pipe you must fix right now, urgent.
